findings.detail: The ticket claims the genuine defect was filed as ticket dd41-239d-6e09-4a86 (alias: rutile-massive-spoonbill) with a discovered_from link to this ticket. However, show_ticket('dd41-239d-6e09-4a86') returns 'Ticket not found', show_ticket('rutile-massive-spoonbill') also returns 'Ticket not found', and search_files for both the ticket id and alias return no matches. The ticket's own deps section only shows the reverse link (discovered_from->0707-59ae-7db6-489b), not the claimed outbound link to dd41. The referenced child ticket cannot be verified as existing in the system.
findings.remediation: File the genuine defect ticket for evidence starvation/non-recovery of suppressed governed reads, ensure it is linked discovered_from this ticket (99d3-8618-654b-4f03), and record the ticket id in a comment here once created.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[operator-attested]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify.
